ios.desc:
You explore freely. Manyou narrates what you find with amazing voice. One app works in any museum and gallery.

Manyou is a museum audio guide that lets you explore at your own pace. Point your camera at an exhibit, take a photo, and hear a narrated story about what you're looking at. No rented audio guides, no fixed routes, and no tiny labels.

See something interesting.
• Take a photo.
• Listen.

That's it.

Why you'll love Manyou:

• Follow your curiosity instead of someone else's route.
• Hear engaging stories, historical context, artistic details, and surprising connections.
• Works with paintings, sculptures, historical artifacts, fossils, scientific exhibits, and more.
• Continue walking while listening.
• Every exhibit you discover is saved to your trip.
• Use your own phone and headphones—no special equipment required.
• Supports 12 languages.

Whether you're visiting an art museum, history museum, science museum, gallery, or cultural site, Manyou helps you spend less time reading labels and more time discovering the stories behind what you see.

Explore freely. Listen deeply. Wander well.

quotes.text:
I built a mobile app that can be your museum companion. You take a photo and hear an AI-generated narration about the exhibit, you can learn more and hear more insightful and detail narration. It's an audio-first app so you don't have to stare at the phone screen and I used the most knowledgable AI and the best voices I can find. I always wanted to walk in a museum/gallery as if I am watching a documentary and finally 2026 is the year all the parts are ready.

Product website: https://manyou.ai/

iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/manyou-museum-gallery-guide/id6763622354

Android: I really wish google has a better developer experience ...

You can try it even if you are not in a museum though the narration would be less relevant.
